db_tools.allowed_tables: # One table name per line. Lines starting with # are ignored. # Only the tables listed here can be read. While this list is empty, every query is refused. # See the field comment in the admin for a starter list you can paste and trim.
db_tools.extra_denied_tables: # One table name per line. Lines starting with # are ignored. # Listed tables are protected on top of the allowlist and can never be read.
